name: Epitech Berlin
overview:
Epitech welcomes you to its Berlin campus for a program focusing on video game development or cybersecurity.


The Berlin campus is located at LUX Cubes, Naglerstr. 4, 10245 Berlin.

The Warschauer Straße, Ostkreuz and Frankfurter Tor stations are easily accessible, offering excellent public transport connections across the city.

You will benefit from proximity to several creative and tech hubs in the Friedrichshain district, with access to a wide range of cafés, restaurants, and collaborative spaces.

The school is situated in one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods, just a short walk from the Spree River and the iconic East Side Gallery.


Berlin is the capital city of Germany and a real dynamic metropolis with a population of 3.7 million people.

With its unique vibe, its thriving cultural scene and nightlife, its rich and divided history, including its diverse architecture, Berlin is one of the most renowned cities in Europe.

Berlin is the city of artists and creatives. You can feel the creative vibe of Berlin every day in its streets, its artists and its start-ups.

Berlin is also known worldwide for its club scene and sense of freedom. People come from all over the world to experience the Berlin vibe.

The city has indeed a bold international community and attracts a large number of international students.
administrative:
1. Visa

No visa is necessary for students who are nationals of a member state of the European Union or for students resident in one of the member states of the European Union and who hold a residence permit in that country.

There are no specific steps to take if you are from a member country of the European Union.


2. Insurance and Health

It is also recommended to apply for the European "Améli" insurance card on ameli.fr. The card is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance and allows you to pay for your care in Europe.

To obtain your card, log into your Ameli account at least two weeks before your departure.

  • You have no documents to provide.
  • This card is valid for one year. If, upon receipt of your card, your card indicates cover until December of the calendar year, please apply again in October / November of the fourth year so that it covers the rest of the school year (up to to June).
  • At the doctor, the pharmacist, and in public service hospitals, present your card or your provisional certificate.
  • Thanks to your European health insurance card, your medical expenses are covered under the same conditions as for the insured in the country that welcomes you.


3. CROUS scholarship (French students)

If you're going to Epitech Berlin for your Tech4, you can have access to the CROUS scholarship.


4. Prepare your arrival

For more information about current events on our campus and to get a sense of what it's like to study at EPITECH Berlin, feel free to check out our Instagram page or TikTok account.

You can find a lot of information here: https://allaboutberlin.com

To find out more on travel advice issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Germany, click here.
accomodation:
On-campus accommodation

EPITECH Berlin does not offer on-campus accommodation.


Off-campus accommodation

Berlin offers a wide range of housing options, but demand remains very high. Finding individual accommodation often requires flexibility and availability for viewings arranged by agencies or private owners, so it’s best to plan a few months for your search. Shared flats are generally easier to secure.


The new Epitech Berlin campus is located at LUX Cubes, Naglerstr. 4–5, 10245 Berlin, in the dynamic Friedrichshain district. The campus benefits from a vibrant, creative environment and is well connected to the rest of the city.


Berlin’s House of Games, a major hub bringing together key players in the video game industry, is expected to open in November 2026 and will integrate Epitech Berlin into its ecosystem.

Important Notes:

  • Many low-cost ads are aimed at holders of WBS (document opening access to social housing) or over 50s.
  • Please note : You must register with the Town Hall (« Formulare -> Anmeldung bei der Meldebehörde ») within 14 days of moving in. At the end of this process, the City Council issues a certificate which can be requested for a large number of procedures (opening a bank account, purchasing a SIM card, etc.). It is boldly recommended that you complete this process as soon as possible.
  • Municipal services receive only by appointment. There may not be an open window for several weeks. However, places are often freed up in the morning for the afternoon of the same day. It is advisable to connect early to get an appointment during the day. The declaration of domicile can be made outside the district of residence. (City Hall website (in German)).
  • A word of advice: it is best to go there so as not to be caught off guard as to the location, the infrastructure at your disposal…
  • Also, beware of scams (beware of advance payment by Western Union).
